title: IH-35 at Wonderworld Drive

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located on the southwest corner of IH-35 and Wonderworld Drive in San Marcos, TX.

rows.label: Frontage
rows.text: The tract has an approximate total frontage of 454 feet along IH-35 and Wonderworld Drive.

rows.label: Utilities
pairs: San Marcos Electric Utility provides water to the property.
Provided by San Marcos Water-Wastewater Utility.
Provided by San Marcos Water-Wastewater Utility.
CenterPoint Energy provides gas to the property.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: General Commercial, City of San Marcos, Texas
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: The property has some floodplain along the frontage at IH-35. See Survey.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property has gentle drainage to the south.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: There are various utility easements and access easements on the property. See Survey.

rows.label: Deed Restrictions
rows.text: Hospitality and banking restrictions are recorded on parts of the property. Prelim title commitment can be provided.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: 2023 Texas Department of Transportation maps indicate 120,768 vehicles per day on IH-35, directly in front of the property and 26,337 vehicles per day on Wonderworld Drive, just east of IH-35.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts are for 2024 and 2029.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The property is surrounded by major retailers, including Sam’s Club, Target, Academy, PetsMart, and Lowe’s which are all at the intersection of IH-35 and Wonderworld Drive or just south of it.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: The property lends itself to a variety of uses, including retail, restaurants, banking or a pharmacy.

comments: The property is on a hard corner at a major intersection along IH-35.
It is surrounded by major retail developments, along with substantial residential and medical development.
There is a reciprocal cross-access easement with the adjacent motel offering direct access to Wonderworld Drive.

qa_notes: INTERNAL CONTRADICTION (demographics): the spec-page table gives 5-mile Population 79,304 and 5-mile Average Household Income $63,497, but the Demographic Overview (p9) gives 5-mile 2024 Estimate 80,176 and Average Household Income $75,830. The 3-mile figures agree (47,325 / $80,534). The spec table appears to come from an older run; transcribed verbatim.
ERROR IN SOURCE: Utilities 'Electricity: San Marcos Electric Utility provides water to the property.' — says 'water' on the electricity line. Kept verbatim; broker should correct to electricity.
Possible contradiction: Deed Restrictions say 'Hospitality and banking restrictions are recorded on parts of the property', while Potential Use lists 'banking' as a suitable use.
Typo: 'PetsMart' in Area Development (brand is PetSmart; the p5 aerial label reads 'PETSMART'). Kept verbatim.

Data vintage is older than the other packages: 2023 TxDOT traffic counts, 2024 ESRI estimates ('ESRI forecasts are for 2024 and 2029'), Demographic Overview dated January 12, 2025. The spec table has only 3- and 5-mile columns; the overview adds 7 miles.

Cover headline is '1.47 ACRE PAD SITE / IH-35 AT WONDERWORLD DRIVE / SAN MARCOS, TX'. The acreage is part of the headline, so it is kept in eyebrow ('1.47 Acre Pad Site') and size_headline is left empty so it does not print twice. Size matches Prismic '1.47 acres'. 64,033 sf / 43,560 = 1.470 ac (consistent; survey p8 '1.470 ACRE TRACT', exhibit p7 '±1.47 ACRES').
City printed as 'San Marcos, TX' (abbreviated state) on the cover and in Location; kept as printed.

Title: PDF 'IH-35 at Wonderworld Drive' (hyphenated); Prismic 'IH 35 at Wonderworld Drive, San Marcos'; Demographic Overview 'IH 35 AT WONDERWORLD DRIVE, SAN MARCOS, TX'. Engineering exhibits spell it 'Wonder World Dr'.
Zoning 'General Commercial, City of San Marcos, Texas' matches Prismic 'General Commercial, City of San Marcos'. Pricing 'Contact Broker.' matches Prismic 'Contact Broker'.

Prismic highlights are shortened: Prismic 'It is surrounded by major retail developments.' vs PDF '..., along with substantial residential and medical development.'; Prismic uses 'IH 35' where the PDF says 'IH-35'. The cross-access easement comment is not in Prismic.
Transaction: PDF never says For Sale or For Lease ('Investment: Contact Broker.'); 'For Sale' used per schema default.
Aerial maps p5 and p6 carry an outdated office address box ('18618 Tuscany Stone, Suite 200, San Antonio, TX 78258'); the disclosure page gives 17721 Rogers Ranch Pkwy., Suite 125.
